intro: Keep your treasures safe and hidden with the NX Seal Floor Lockers. Its concealed floor-mounted design keeps your valuables secure, out of sight, and out of reach, while offering 10X stronger protection.

features.title: Double Throw Mechanical Lock
features.text: This lock employs a dual-throw mechanism that provides deeper bolt engagement for enhanced structural strength. It ensures dependable, tamper-resistant security through precise mechanical operation.

features.title: Steel Shooting Bolts
features.text: The robust steel shooting bolts deliver secure multi-point reinforcement against forced entry, ensuring dependable and elevated security performance.

features.title: Reinforced Door
features.text: The locker incorporates a reinforced door structure designed to withstand higher impact and forced-entry attempts. Its robust construction enhances overall security, ensuring long-term durability and reliable protection.

features.title: Hidden Hinges
features.text: The locker is designed with concealed hinges that minimise the risk of external tampering and enhance structural security. This design also contributes to a clean, seamless exterior for a refined appearance.

features.title: Concealed Design
features.text: Designed for complete discretion, the floor-mounted safe stays fully out of sight when positioned under floors or furniture such as beds. Its concealed installation enhances protection by preventing easy detection.

features.title: Grouting
features.text: Designed for ultimate protection,this feature allows you to securely grout the safe to floors, or inside drawers using robust anchor bolts. By firmly fastening the locker in place, it becomes significantly more resistant to tampering or unauthorized removal, providing an extra layer of security.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. It is Recommended to anchor the Locker with bolts from the bottom as well as the back into a cupboard or onto the wall.
